description:
LAPD Revolutionizes Urban Policing with BULLS Sentinel 3.0 E-Bikes
The BULLS Sentinel 3.0 was designed in close collaboration with the Los Angeles Police Department (LAPD) to meet the unique demands of urban law enforcement. A key feature is its custom frame geometry, including a high top tube specifically engineered to prevent the officer’s utility belt from catching or snagging on the saddle during mounting and dismounting—enhancing both safety and mobility. Combined with its powerful 28 mph Bosch motor, high-capacity battery, and tactical-ready features, the Sentinel 3.0 is redefining eBike patrol standards across the country.

Motor and Battery

Motor: Powered by the Bosch Performance Line Speed Gen4 motor, offering 85Nm of torque and pedal assist up to 28 mph. Fast, quiet, and reliable for quick responses.

Battery: Integrated Bosch PowerTube 625Wh battery for extended range and sleek appearance. Fully charges in approximately 4.9 hours.

Suspension and Frame

Fork: SR Suntour Lytro 35 Supreme SL Air Boost fork with 120mm travel for comfort on streets, curbs, and unpaved shortcuts.

Frame: Aluminum 6061 frame with internal cable routing and LAPD-optimized geometry. The high top tube design improves clearance from police utility belts for safer mounting and dismounting. Available in S / M / L / XL / XXL.

Drivetrain and Brakes

Gears: Smooth-shifting Shimano XT 11-speed drivetrain handles steep inclines and fast flat-out pursuits with ease.

Brakes: Magura MT5 front (4-piston) and MT4 rear (2-piston) hydraulic disc brakes with 203mm front / 180mm rear rotors for immediate and controlled braking power.

Wheels and Tires

Wheels: Agile and strong 27.5" wheels ideal for navigating tight turns and crowded streets.

Tires: Equipped with Schwalbe Smart Sam Double Defense 2.4" tires for grip and puncture resistance on all urban surfaces.

Additional Features

Display: The compact, glove-friendly Bosch Kiox display gives real-time stats including speed, range, assist level, and ride time.

Pedals: Includes Wellgo B249DU platform pedals with grip for patrol boots or regular shoes.

Saddle: Fitted with a WTB Speed Sport saddle for resistance and comfort during extended patrol hours.

Technology and Design

Rack & Bag: Custom-equipped with a Topeak rear rack and matching Topeak bag featuring Velcro-attach POLICE signage. Provides storage for gear, first-aid kits, or communication tools—all while making the bike unmistakably official.

Class-3 eBike: Pedal assist up to 28 mph makes the Sentinel ideal for fast-paced urban response and long-range patrol shifts.

Key Takeaways

The BULLS Sentinel 3.0 is a mission-built, Class-3 eBike developed with direct feedback from the LAPD. It blends speed, durability, utility, and safety—empowering officers with an efficient and sustainable way to patrol modern cities. Whether you're a public agency or a private security operation, this bike is ready for duty.
